cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-1
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: I currently work as a first officer on short- and medium-haul passenger flights. My duties include flight preparation, aircraft operation, radio communication and monitoring under the commander's authority. Learners should replace this example with their real position and responsibilities.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：我目前在中短程客运航班担任副驾驶。我的职责包括飞行准备、飞机操作、无线电通信，以及在机长指挥下实施监控。学习者应根据自己的真实职位和职责替换这个示例。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-2
cards.audioText: Could you describe your work background?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否介绍一下自己的工作经历？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: I began with basic flight training, worked as a flight instructor to build experience and later joined an airline as a first officer. I completed company ground school, simulator training and supervised line flying before normal operations. This is a model sequence and should be adapted to the learner's actual background.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：我从基础飞行训练开始，之后担任飞行教员积累经验，后来加入航空公司成为副驾驶。在参加正常运行前，我完成了公司地面课程、模拟机训练和在监督下的航线飞行。这只是示范性的经历顺序，应根据学习者的实际背景调整。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-3
cards.audioText: When and where did you complete your most recent transition training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次转机型训练是在何时、何地完成的？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: I completed my most recent transition course last year at my operator's approved training centre. It included ground instruction, fixed-base and full-flight simulator sessions, a skill test and supervised line training. Learners should substitute their actual date, location and approved course details.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：我去年在运营人批准的训练中心完成了最近一次转机型课程。课程包括地面教学、固定式模拟训练器和全动模拟机训练、技能考试以及在监督下的航线训练。学习者应替换为自己的真实日期、地点和批准课程细节。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-4
cards.audioText: Which aircraft type did your most recent transition training cover?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次转机型训练针对哪种机型？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: the course covered transition to the Airbus A320 family. It focused on aircraft systems, normal and abnormal procedures, performance, automation, crew coordination and simulator handling. This is only a model answer and does not claim a real type qualification.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：课程涵盖空客 A320 系列的转机型训练，重点包括飞机系统、正常与非正常程序、性能、自动化、机组协调和模拟机操纵。这只是一段示范答案，并不声称具有真实机型资格。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-5
cards.audioText: Have you completed any high-performance aircraft training? If so, what did it cover?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否完成过高性能航空器训练？如果有，培训内容是什么？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: I completed high-performance aircraft training that covered faster energy changes, swept-wing aerodynamics, high-altitude operations, pressurization and advanced automation. The course combined classroom study with simulator exercises for normal and abnormal situations. Learners should describe only training they have actually completed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：我完成过高性能飞机训练，内容包括更快的能量变化、后掠翼空气动力学、高空运行、增压和先进自动化。课程结合课堂学习与正常、异常情况的模拟机练习。学习者只能描述自己实际完成过的训练。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-6
cards.audioText: When and where did you complete your high-performance flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在何时、何地完成了高性能飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: I completed high-performance flight training two years ago at an approved training center in Shanghai. The fictional course included ground lessons and simulator sessions on higher-speed operation, rapid energy changes and complex aircraft systems. Learners should state their actual date, place and course scope, or explain that they have not completed such training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：两年前，我在上海一家获批训练中心完成了高性能飞机训练。这项虚构课程包括地面教学，以及有关高速运行、快速能量变化和复杂飞机系统的模拟机训练。学习者应说明真实日期、地点和课程范围，或说明自己没有完成过这类训练。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-7
cards.audioText: How many flight hours did you accumulate during high-performance flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在高性能飞行训练期间积累了多少飞行小时？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: I accumulated ten actual aircraft flight hours during the high-performance course. I also completed forty simulator hours, which I record separately and do not count as aircraft flight time. Learners must use their own verified training and logbook records or say that they have not completed this type of training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：我在高性能飞机课程中积累了十小时真实飞机飞行时间。我还完成了四十小时模拟机训练，这些时间单独记录，不计入飞机飞行时间。学习者必须使用自己经过核实的训练和飞行记录，或者说明没有完成过这类训练。
